title: Conditional κ = 0.003151787: clean donor-transport merge
body:
This supplies a **new locally verified whole conditional κ = 0.003151787**, improving exact PR6375’s 0.00315120 by 0.000000587 (about 0.0186%). It merges a rank-4 and rank-1 native climb into one rank-5 query, transports the intermediate export through an already-paid donor, and removes the remaining rank-one endpoint error with an explicitly zero-restored scratch lifetime.

The helper targets and fixed 19-call balanced caller are unchanged. The gain is H4 + H1 − H5 per native call; the extra 508 scalar-allowance units are charged. The complete bill has 14,214 productive fields, 70,694 paid calls and rank-mass surplus 808. This is a conditional bound claim, beyond a component price screen; the .005 objective remains unmet.

**Evidence:** the portable verifier regenerates every scientific word field and checks all 799 columns / 638,401 coefficients, exact new-scratch cleanup, 2,940 native maps including absolute phases, 208 main adapters, 1,124 helper normalizers, 7,904 physical caller contacts, 53,248 central-square columns, the separate Laurent caller, two rational price engines, compiler/precision costs and all 54 strict plus 4 functional outer predicates. Omitted uncomputation and public correction reject. The raw crossing is enclosed in (0.00315179488707, 0.00315179488708); the claimed whole bound uses tested saving 0.003151792 and the complete outer ledger.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12 and TMPDIR pointing to writable temporary storage:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-clean-piggyback
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-clean-piggyback --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Both registered normal and assertion-disabled full commands passed locally on CPython 3.12.14. Exact source/commit/mode checks and the official 23-file export/input-coverage check pass. The package includes the full proof, complete cost receipt, source pins, deterministic constructor, corruption controls, retained notices and explicit price-adapter edits. The precursor complete local admission also passed separately from this portable packaging.

**Scope:** native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape and analytic_recovery remain inherited conditional assumptions. Separate same-author arithmetic engines do not establish independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. The uniform word and rounded multiplier are not materialized; inherited erasure is not discharged by proving the one new scratch zero. No selected-frontier update is requested. Draft status leaves independent scientific review and hosted CI visible.

Only the new isolated package is added. Exact PR6375 source commit `247b5c319b9f58fe9ee61dbf80697f8a9a429831` is retained in publication history with a lineage-only merge; its pending package trees are not imported or modified. Canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority 8. The final live refresh found newly opened [PR6398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6398), which claims a stronger whole conditional bound about .003286215 using a different caller on this same native source. That caller was not independently replayed here. Our native merge is distinct, but this nineteen-call composition is no longer the largest published claim; composition with the new caller remains unverified. Bounded coverage is not exhaustive novelty certification.

Credit DreamingOfClouds / PR6375 for shared-carrier lifts, Ali Romman / PR6348 for the balanced caller, DreamingOfClouds / PR6144 and Ali Romman / PR5827 for the retained checker chain, and the full P104/native/helper/BIT/compiler/outer lineage in NOTICE. New construction/proof/package by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. The rank-one inverse identity is classical. Open next questions are independent source-bound review and a substantially cheaper native word toward .005.
